heading: Dinner's at 7. The band's on at 8. Aqua-aerobics is at 9 tomorrow. One app finds all of it.
subhead: Your hotel is a Supermarket, Audeohost is your flyer - dining, stage and screen, theatre, and a home away from home, all through a single door. Audeohost-Events is a single guest facing app in hyper-local settings, but especially when a potential guest is planning their journey and wants to see what on the menu!
